title: A survey on bias in visual datasets
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey on the topic of bias in visual datasets. Its central theme is an ethical one, focusing on fairness, discrimination, and the ethical implications of biased data in Computer Vision systems. The work is dedicated to identifying, quantifying, and discussing an ethical problem, making ethics a core component of the research, rather than a brief consideration.
